g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_front: Keys: 1000 x 600 x 800 mm envelope - the node size_mm (study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)); the build fills it exactly (hold-down frame + vent riser pin the box)

Graph revision AD - ga_front: Pumped-hydro powerhouse set per the node backup_basis (A-M-145 lane; Q-006/Q-009 closed): the diverse N+1 backup of ZNBR2 (third source FUEL_CELL) to NFPA 111 Level 1, Class X - 14 h at the 14.46 kW critical load = 202.4 kWh at the bus

Graph revision AD - ga_front: Machine envelopes per plan rule 6: turbine (14.46 kW discharge at 36.21 m head, eta 0.8), generator, pump-motor (49.6 kW recharge over the PV window, eta 0.85; round trip 0.68), electrical cabinet; buffer manifold vessel (study, W12)
